# name: The twins' sentence on Xibalba; their fathers honoured; sun and moon
# title: Cate puch ta xqui biyh qui bi
# fols: fols. 31v–32v
Cate puch ta xqui biyh qui bi, xqui cobizah quib chi qui vach conohel Xibalba.

“Chitaa ca bi, xchi ca biyh; xchi ca biyh naipuch vbi ca cahau chive. Oh va, oh Xhunahpu, Xbalanque, ca bi. Are cu ca cahau ri xi camizah, Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu qui bi. Oh cu pacol re vae qui rail, qui caxcol ri ca cahau. Quehecut mi xca cuyu vi ronohel caxcol mi xi ban chique. Quehecut quix ca zach vi ivonohel; quix camizah; mahabi chic colotahel chive,” xe vꜭhax cut.

Cate puch que tahic coquic conohel Xibalba: “Tocob ca vach, ix Hunahpu, Xbalanque! Quiꜩih vi xoh macunic chique ri i cahau qui biyh la, cute e mucul chi Pucbal Chah,” xeꜭha cut.

“Vꜩ bala. Are ba ri ca ꜩih xchi ca biyh chive. Chitaa ivonohel, ix Xibalba: rumal mana nim chi quih ivalaxic chuxic, ruꜭ naipuch mavi nim chi i cochibal, x zcaquin chic chi quic holomax; mavi chu hom quic ive. Xa xot, xa acam, xa chuch chire xheraxic; xa naipu ral quim, ral tolob chive chah. Ma cu ivech ri ronohel zaquil al, zaquil ꜭahol; xa noh chi ꜩaco rib chi vach. Are ri ahmac, ahlabal, ahbiz, ahmoquer, chac na vmac, quix oc vi. Mana xa rax chapom ronohel vinac chi bano; quix taon puch chuvi ri quic holomax,” xe vꜭhax cut conohel Xibalba.

Quehecut licarinac qui zachic, v maixic, naipuch qui ziquixic. Maui nim qui quih oher; xa xrah ꜩa vi vinac oher. Quiꜩih mana cabauil qui bi oher; xavi xibal iꜩel qui vach, e ahꜩa, ahtucur, e tacchinel chi mac, chi labal.

E naipu ahmuculic ꜭux, e quecail zaquil, ahmoxvach, ahlaꜩab que vꜭhaxic. Chi xe on qui vach que culutahic. Quehe cut v zachic qui nimal, cacal; maui nim chi cahavarem xuxic. Are xe banou ri Xhunahpu, Xbalanque.

Are cut coquic ca ziquin ri catit chuvach ri ah, ri xquitic canoc. Xpe vtux ri ah, cate xchaquih chic; are cut ta xe cat pa choh, ta xpe chicut vtux ri ah.

Cate cut xcaton ri catit, xucat ri pom chuvach ri ah, v natabal quech riy. Are xquicot vi v ꜭux catit ri chu camul xpe vtux ri ah. Ta xcabauilax rumal catit, ta xu binahzah cut Nicah Ha, Nicah bi choc.

Cazam Ah, Chatam Vleu vbi xuxic. Are cut xu binaah vi Nicah Ha, Nicah bi choc, rumal xa chu nicahal vpa cochoch xquitic ah. Are chi cu xu binaah vi Chatam Vleu, Cazam Ah chuvi Chatam Vleu quitic vi ah. Are naipu xu binaah vi Cazam Ah, rumal xpe vtux ah; ta xcoh vbi rumal Xmucane, xquitic canoc Hunahpu, Xbalanque, xa natabal que rumal catit.

Are curi nabe qui cahau xoheroc que camoc ri Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu; xquil chicut vvach ri qui cahau chila chi Xibalba. Xꜭhau chic qui cahau chi quetax, xqui chac Xibalba.

Va cute vviquic chic qui cahau cumal; are xquivic ri Vvcub Hunahpu. Chila xbe qui vica vi chi Pucbal Chah; xavi xere vvach xrah vxic. Xꜩonox cut chire vbi, ronohel vchi, vꜩam, vbac vvach. Xuric nabe vbi, xa cu zcaquin chic. Xchatah vi xere; maui xu biyh chi vbi ri v Hunahpuil vchi; xere pu xchatah chivi.

Quehe cut ta xqui nimah vi canahoc v ꜭux qui cahau; xavi xcanah chi Pucbal Chah chivi. “Quix ziquix vi chuxic,” xeꜭha chi vꜭahol chirech, ta xcubax v ꜭux. “Nabe chel ive, nabe naipuch quix quihiloxic rumal zaquil al, zaquil ꜭahol; maui chi zachic i bi. Ta chuxoc!” xeꜭha chirech qui cahau, ta xqui cuba v ꜭux. “Xa oh pacol i camic, i zachic, caxcol rail xban chive.”

Quehe cut qui pixabic ri xchacatahinac oc ronohel Xibalba. Ta xe acan culoc varale nicah zac; huzu cu xe acan chi cah. Hun cu quih, hun naipu ic chique; ta xzaquiric vpam cah, vvach vleu; chi cah xe ꜭohe vi.

Are cut ca chacanic ri omuch ꜭaholab xe cam rumal Zipacna; are cut cachbil xuxic; e vchumilal cah xe vxic.
